title: Agent Witness Conformance Profile v0.1
normative_notes: AWC v0.1 does not define a parallel wire format. Exports MUST use witnessdiff.reference-trace/v1 and witnessdiff.evidence-bundle/v1.
Implementors MAY ship exporters; conformance is measured by this fixture suite and the documented grader pipeline.
AWC preflight rules are normative for INVALID_INPUT outcomes listed in awc-verdicts-v0.1.json.
